stem.text: A golf club hits a golf ball. The graph shows how the force $F$ on the ball varies with time $t$.

stem.alt: Graph with vertical axis F and horizontal axis t. A triangular line rises from the origin to a peak and falls back to the t-axis.

stem.text: Which graph shows how the velocity $v$ of the ball varies with time $t$?

A.alt: Graph with vertical axis v and horizontal axis t. A curve starts at the origin and rises at a decreasing gradient, then steepens towards the upper right.

B.alt: Graph with vertical axis v and horizontal axis t. A curve starts flat at the origin, rises steeply in the middle, then levels off at the upper right.

C.alt: Graph with vertical axis v and horizontal axis t. A horizontal line at a constant value of v runs from the v-axis to a vertical line, which extends below the t-axis.

D.alt: Graph with vertical axis v and horizontal axis t. A straight line rises from the origin to a peak, drops vertically to below the t-axis, then rises back to the t-axis at the right.
